name: rover
subject: the RELAY "rover" ship, a fast agile interceptor spacecraft
identity: A long, slender arrowhead hull in dark navy #111834 with bold neon cyan #4ff0d8 edge lines and violet #a86bff secondary accents. A sharp narrow nose points straight up. Two swept-back wings flare out wide behind the middle of the hull, ending in sharp tips. Two thin separate tail streaks trail straight down from the rear, like afterimage ribbons. A small bright cyan core in the hull center. Thin and fast-looking, much narrower than it is tall. Hard-edged flat geometric silhouette, clean bold lines of one even weight, no realistic texture, no metal shading, no panel detail. Glow only on the hull edges and the core.
